# PyData Helsinki

> A meetup group of Python and data enthusiasts in Helsinki, Finland. Free monthly meetups in English with talks on machine learning, data engineering, MLOps, visualization, and statistical modeling using open-source tools. Part of PyData, an educational program of NumFOCUS.

Every page on this site has a markdown version at `index.md` next to the HTML, e.g. https://pydata-helsinki.fi/events/2026-08-12-visma/index.md.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/index.md): About the meetup, upcoming and past events, organisers, community links
- [Events](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/events/index.md): All meetups, upcoming and past, with talks and speakers, linking to a page per event
- [For speakers](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/for-speakers/index.md): How to give a talk — formats, topics, schedule, practicalities
- [For companies](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/for-companies/index.md): How to host or sponsor a meetup

## Feeds

- [JSON feed](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/events.json): Events as JSON Feed 1.1, with structured event data (times, venue, talks, registration) in a `_pydata_helsinki_event` extension
- [Atom feed](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/feed.xml)
- [Calendar](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/events.ics): Events as iCalendar

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://pydata-helsinki.fi/sitemap.xml)
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@PyData_Helsinki): Recordings of past talks
- [Meetup group](https://www.meetup.com/pydata-helsinki/): Event registration (the registration platform is likely to change in the future)
